name: feature-hero
title: Feature AI Cards
description: A centred heading and paragraph over five icon features: three across the top, two beneath. The middle item is scaled up with a filled blue icon to mark it as the key one.
use: Five short capabilities need an even, centred layout with one highlighted as the strongest.
avoid: Feature copy is baked into the file, and the pale stripes plus glow assume a light page.
a11y: Nothing is focusable, so the hover highlight is decorative only, and reduced motion is never checked. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white page with faint diagonal pinstripes and a blue glow rising from the bottom edge. A centred headline and grey paragraph sit above five features arranged three then two, each with a small round icon over a bold title and short grey description.
behaves: The heading and cards fade up into place once as the section enters the viewport. The middle feature keeps a larger filled blue icon and slight scale, while the others lighten their icon circle on hover.
customise: Titles, descriptions and icon choices come from the features array; the stripe angle and blue glow stops are in the section classes.
weight: light: Five static cards with one fade-up; the backdrop is pure CSS.
demo: Headline 'Empower Your Business with AI-Driven Precision' with cards such as AI Campaign Optimization.
issues: The five features are fixed in the source, with no way to pass a different list.
Feature icons are unlabelled SVGs; only the adjacent titles carry the meaning.
polishWhy: Even spacing and a distinctive glow-and-stripe backdrop; the middle emphasis is subtle.
